messages:
amy (Oncall): starting this follow-up thread for last night's failover. main asks: 1) audit log gaps between 02:14-02:40 UTC, 2) collect evidence for compliance, 3) schedule postmortem + action items. tagging sec + infra.

ben (Security): saw the gap. CloudTrail shows no events for the pool rotation window. S3 has objects but a handful of files are zero-byte (rotation job likely errored). :thinking_face:

mike (SRE): confirmed — rotation job crashed on a transient NFS mount timeout. We had a hot restart; some audit uploads failed. I pulled host syslogs from the node that ran the job.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-9847 acknowledged by amy (Oncall).

ben (Security): action: start evidence collection thread. priority: preserve original artifacts + immutable snapshot. I can run the S3 object version dump and CloudTrail full export.

kevin (Eng-Infra): how do you want the host-level logs? I can snapshot the instance (ami) and create a forensic copy to a sec-controlled bucket.

ben (Security): yes please. steps I need:
```
# S3 object versions for the 02:00-03:00 UTC window
aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-audit-logs --prefix 2026/03/12/02/ --query 'Versions[].{Key:Key,VersionId:VersionId,Size:Size}' --profile sec-collector

# Download to secure location
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-logs/2026/03/12/02/ /tmp/audit-evidence --recursive --profile sec-collector

# CloudTrail export
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-12T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-12T03:00:00Z --profile sec-collector > /tmp/cloudtrail-02-03.json
```

ben (Security): if S3 versioning missing -> grab object metadata, request S3 access logs from storage team, and preserve the lifecycle config. Also collect KMS key rotation logs and KMS usage in CloudWatch.

kevin (Eng-Infra): ok will snapshot the instance and copy /var/log/journal and /opt/redwood/audit-uploader logs to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/PD-9847/ (write-once retention). Will also lock lifecycle to prevent deletion (temp).

jorge (Support): customer-facing note: do we have list of affected customers? I prepared a quick assessment earlier — only 3 Dedicated accounts with audit ingestion during failover. I can share list privately.

amy (Oncall): @jorge share the list in #support-private please. We need to know who to notify for compliance impact.

lina (PM): scheduling: propose postmortem Fri 10:00 PT (recorded). agenda: timeline, root cause, evidence collected, remediation plan, follow-ups for compliance. Anyone object?

mike (SRE): fine with Fri 10. I will bring timeline and deploy logs.

ben (Security): fine. I want 20m to review evidence and confirm whether logs can be reconstructed. If not, we likely need to notify SOC and Compliance and log a control gap.

amy (Oncall): immediate action items:
- A1: Collect immutable evidence (ben, kevin) — due EOD today.
- A2: Produce customer impact list & notify plan (jorge) — due EOD today.
- A3: Create postmortem doc and invite (lina) — due EOD today.
- A4: Root-cause fix for rotation job crash (mike) — P0 PR by Tue.
(adding these to JIRA CRE-2102)

ben (Security): noted. I'll attach evidence to CRE-2102. Also: we need to audit IAM changes for the last 24 hours — suspicious access could explain missing writes. Running lookup now.

kevin (Eng-Infra): inventory of nodes that had upload attempts: red-node-12, red-node-13. snapshot started (AMI-2345) and copy in progress.

incident-bot: Reminder: next on-call handoff in 2h.

mike (SRE): small note on mitigations: added retry and exponential backoff to uploader config in staging. will validate and push a canary tomorrow. If that fixes the race w/ NFS mount, it should stop zero-byte objects.

ben (Security): evidence checklist (for compliance):
- CloudTrail full export for window
- S3 object versions + metadata
- Instance snapshot + /var/log/journal
- Audit-uploader logs and exit codes
- KMS access logs and key metadata
- IAM change history for 24h
- Timeline from SRE (deploys, restarts)

lina (PM): I'll create the postmortem doc in Confluence and link CRE-2102. please add notes directly.

jorge (Support): notifying impacted customers tomorrow morning unless security says otherwise. I'll coordinate messaging with legal/compliance.

ben (Security): one more: do NOT restore or modify any objects in redwood-audit-logs until we snapshot. writes to that bucket are disabled for the moment.

amy (Oncall): thanks all. Ben/kevin please confirm when evidence snapshot URL is ready and share S3 presigned paths to compliance-ops. Also ping me when CRE-2102 has evidence attachments.

ben (Security): will update here when done. :white_check_mark:

kevin (Eng-Infra): uploading to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/PD-9847/ now. ETA 45m.

amy (Oncall): booking postmortem Fri 10:00 PT, invite sent. If anything critical comes up before then, re-open this thread.

mike (SRE): quick note on access controls: need to lock down uploader service role — it had broad s3:PutObject permissions across the bucket. will propose a least-privilege role as part of remediation.

ben (Security): agree. add A5: IAM role hardening (ben + mike) — due next Wed.

lina (PM): tracked actions: A1,A2,A3,A4,A5. I'll own follow-up tracking and run the postmortem.

amy (Oncall): last: please add any evidence hashes here (sha256) once uploaded so we can reference immutable evidence in compliance notes.

kevin (Eng-Infra): checksum list:
- cloudtrail-02-03.json -> sha256: d4f7c9a9b6e2...
- uploader-node12-journal.tar.gz -> sha256: 8b2a1f5c3e9...
(placeholder, will post full)

ben (Security): uploaded initial artifacts to sec bucket and attached to CRE-2102. sharing presigned links via DM to compliance.

jorge (Support): confirmed list of impacted customers shared in #support-private. legal looped in.

amy (Oncall): ok closing thread for now. reopen if more evidence needed. thanks everyone. :pray:
